Setting: SSPR Registration Coverage At Least 90 Percent (Among SSPR-Enabled Users)
Recommendation: Drive SSPR registration coverage above 90% among users the tenant allows to use it. Note: whether SSPR should be enabled at all is customer-specific - a fully cloud-native, passwordless-only tenant with no password to reset may not need SSPR in scope; this check only reports registration hygiene among users it is currently enabled for.
